findings.message: External input (network, user) flows to a code execution sink. This enables remote code execution or command injection.
findings.pattern: Tainted flow: 'cmd' from input (line 166, user input) → subprocess.run (code execution)
findings.remediation: Never pass external input to exec(), eval(), os.system(), or subprocess without strict validation. Use allowlists and parameterized commands instead.
